name: Quickened Pandemoniac Corruption (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Pandemoniac Corruption, Ability Focus (pandemoniac corruption), Knowledge (the planes) 9 ranks, Outsider native to a chaotically-aligned plane.

Benefit(s): Your pandemoniac corruption only incubates for the duration of the encounter after your victim has been injured by your natural attacks, and one full round after the disease manifests, the creature suffers 1 point of Constitution damage per round until he dies when his Constitution score reaches 0 (which may be immediately considering the 1d10+5 penalty to Constitution).
